about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Ayesha Iqbal, a Full-Stack AI Engineer who builds production-minded web applications and intelligent AI products from concept to deployment.

My engineering spans modern full-stack architectures, database systems, authentication, and payments, with deep specialization in autonomous AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations — leveraging the OpenAI Agents SDK, OpenAI API, and Gemini APIs.

Having shipped 8 live production applications, I focus on building reliable, human-centered systems: whether that's an editorial AI newsroom with quality scoring, an evidence intelligence platform for medical researchers, or high-throughput inventory engines with atomic checkout.

featuredProjects.name: Assay AI Prompt Lab
featuredProjects.tagline: Systematic prompt A/B testing lab with automated scoring and 3D visual analytics.
featuredProjects.positioning: A scientific prompt evaluation platform that compares AI prompts side by side against real test cases with multi-criteria scoring, token analytics, and interactive 3D visualizations.
featuredProjects.description: Assay turns prompt tweaking into a repeatable scientific experiment. It allows engineers to compare two AI prompts simultaneously on identical test cases with automated scoring (exact match, regex, JSON validation) and real-time telemetry for latency, token usage, and cost.
featuredProjects.problem: AI developers and prompt engineers waste hours manually testing prompt iterations in chatbots with no repeatable baseline, objective metrics, or regression tracking.
featuredProjects.solution: Assay provides a structured lab where prompt variants run against identical test suites in parallel. Scoring engines automatically validate outputs, calculate pass rates, and render 3D performance graphs, supporting both English and Roman Urdu.
features: Side-by-side prompt A/B testing with identical test inputs
Automated multi-method scoring: exact match, regex patterns, and JSON schema validation
Performance telemetry: pass rate, latency benchmarks, token usage, and API cost calculation
Interactive 3D performance visualizations powered by React Three Fiber
Experiment history tracking with persistent comparison analytics
Bilingual user interface supporting English and Roman Urdu
architecture: Next.js App Router for high-performance frontend interface and test runner
Supabase PostgreSQL for storing prompt templates, test suites, and experiment records
React Three Fiber & Three.js for interactive 3D visual analytics
Deployed on Vercel with responsive dark-theme design system
decisions: Implemented multi-criteria evaluators (JSON schema, regex, string match) instead of naive string equality
Leveraged React Three Fiber for visual cluster inspection of prompt performance metrics
featuredProjects.results: Transforms subjective prompt engineering into an objective, data-driven workflow, reducing iteration time from hours to seconds.

featuredProjects.name: Clinical Evidence Intelligence
featuredProjects.tagline: AI medical research platform querying PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov and wider literature.
featuredProjects.positioning: An autonomous multi-agent evidence intelligence platform that retrieves, verifies, and maps findings across PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and peer-reviewed literature.
featuredProjects.description: Clinical Evidence Intelligence deploys dedicated research agents that query medical databases in parallel, extract findings, and strictly verify every claim against source text. It detects disagreements across divergent clinical trials and builds an interactive evidence map.
featuredProjects.problem: Medical researchers face an overwhelming volume of published studies, making it difficult to systematically compare trials, cross-check claims, and uncover conflicting findings.
featuredProjects.solution: The platform orchestrates parallel research agents across PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and peer-reviewed literature via Tavily. Every claim is checked against source text excerpts, conflicting studies are surfaced explicitly, and users can ask questions grounded directly in specific papers.
features: Parallel multi-agent retrieval across PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Tavily literature
Strict claim-to-source excerpt citation checking with zero hallucination tolerance
Automated conflict and consensus detection across divergent clinical trials
Interactive visual evidence map showing direction and strength of clinical findings
'Ask This Paper' conversational query grounded strictly in single paper texts
PICO (Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome) query normalization
architecture: Next.js and TypeScript frontend with medical-grade typographic hierarchy
Multi-agent orchestration engine executing parallel asynchronous literature queries
PubMed E-utilities and ClinicalTrials.gov REST API integration
Supabase database for literature caching, citation tracking, and evidence graphs
decisions: Architected strict excerpt verification so no claim is accepted without exact source backing
Surfaced clinical contradictions explicitly rather than smoothing them into an average
featuredProjects.results: Demonstrates high-stakes, domain-specific AI agent architecture with evidence-backed provenance and conflict detection.

featuredProjects.name: WireRoom AI — Editorial Newsroom
featuredProjects.tagline: Autonomous multi-agent editorial pipeline with typed contracts and human review gate.
featuredProjects.positioning: A 5-stage autonomous editorial infrastructure that turns topics into verified, publication-ready articles with SSE streaming, Zod contracts, and a human approval gate.
featuredProjects.description: WireRoom AI orchestrates a 5-stage pipeline taking a topic through research, drafting, editing + SEO, evidence verification, and human review. It utilizes typed agent contracts, Zod validation, SSE streaming, and a composite quality score.
featuredProjects.problem: Generative AI produces generic, unverified articles with hallucinated facts, poor SEO structure, and zero human editorial control.
featuredProjects.solution: WireRoom decomposes editorial production into 5 typed stages: Research (structured claims), Draft (coherent narrative), Edit + SEO (clarity & metadata), Verify (evidence coverage), and Human Review (final approval). Every run exposes quality metrics before publishing.
features: 5-stage autonomous editorial pipeline (Research, Draft, Edit, Verify, Human Review)
Typed agent contracts with runtime Zod validation, automated retries, and timeouts
Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming progress and live agent telemetry
Real-time composite quality score: Evidence (95%), Citations (92%), Structure (94%), SEO (91%)
Human-in-the-loop approval gate preventing unauthorized publishing
Interactive 3D newsroom telemetry visualization powered by Three.js
architecture: Next.js App Router with SSE streaming endpoints for real-time stage updates
OpenAI and Tavily API integration for deep automated research
Supabase database for article revisions, citations, and editorial audit logs
Vitest test suite verifying agent contract schemas and transition states
decisions: Separated each editorial role into its own typed contract with strict input/output schemas
Enforced a human review gate before any story is marked publishable
featuredProjects.results: Presents production-grade multi-agent orchestration that balances autonomous AI velocity with strict human editorial control.

featuredProjects.name: SmartDesk AI — Customer Support Agent
featuredProjects.tagline: AI customer-support platform with knowledge-based answers and human escalation.
featuredProjects.positioning: An AI customer-support platform that turns a business's own FAQs and policies into an agent that answers customers instantly — and knows when to step aside for a human.
featuredProjects.description: SmartDesk is an AI customer-support platform where businesses provide FAQs, policies, and knowledge to an AI support agent that answers customer questions and escalates conversations to human representatives when necessary.
featuredProjects.problem: Support teams spend hours answering repetitive questions, while generic bots frequently hallucinate answers or trap users in frustrating dead-ends.
featuredProjects.solution: Businesses manage FAQs and policies in SmartDesk, which uses the OpenAI Agents SDK to answer customer questions within strict policy bounds. Unresolved queries escalate gracefully to human staff and log into the knowledge portal for continuous improvement.
features: AI agent powered by OpenAI Agents SDK trained on business FAQs and policies
Context-aware, grounded responses with strict scope boundaries
Graceful escalation to human support agents with full conversation history
Unanswered question logging and continuous knowledge base enrichment
Authenticated admin dashboard for managing knowledge and viewing telemetry
architecture: Next.js and TypeScript frontend for customer chat widget and management dashboard
Supabase PostgreSQL for storing knowledge base content, tickets, and conversation data
OpenAI Agents SDK powering support-agent logic and tool calling
Authentication gating access to the knowledge-base management portal
Deployed on Vercel
decisions: Used OpenAI Agents SDK rather than raw completions to enforce structured tool calls and escalation paths
Kept the knowledge base editable through an authenticated dashboard without requiring code changes
featuredProjects.results: Demonstrates end-to-end AI product thinking: taking an LLM beyond a simple chatbot into a scoped, business-specific support agent with a real escalation path.

featuredProjects.name: Nexora Commerce — Inventory Management
featuredProjects.tagline: Multi-warehouse inventory platform with atomic database transactions and Stripe checkout.
featuredProjects.positioning: An enterprise-grade inventory and commerce platform that enforces single-transaction inventory adjustments to eliminate overselling across multi-warehouse operations.
featuredProjects.description: Nexora Commerce manages multi-warehouse stock, variants, and SKUs where orders adjust inventory inside atomic database transactions. Includes organization-level Row-Level Security (RLS), low-stock automated alerts, audit logging, and a Stripe storefront with idempotent webhooks.
featuredProjects.problem: Fast-moving commerce operations frequently experience overselling and concurrency bugs when inventory is modified across uncoordinated API calls.
featuredProjects.solution: Nexora synchronizes multi-warehouse stock, variants, and SKUs using PostgreSQL database transactions. Orders move inventory atomically, accompanied by organization-level RLS, low-stock triggers, and idempotent Stripe webhooks.
features: Multi-warehouse inventory synchronization across variants and SKUs
Atomic PostgreSQL transaction locks blocking overselling during concurrent checkouts
Organization-scoped Row-Level Security (RLS) ensuring strict tenant data isolation
Automated low-stock threshold alerts and complete audit logging
Integrated Stripe test storefront with cryptographically verified idempotent webhooks
architecture: Next.js App Router storefront and administrative dashboard
Supabase PostgreSQL with stored procedures for atomic inventory locking
Stripe webhook listeners ensuring reliable order fulfillment
Tailwind CSS for high-density enterprise dashboard interfaces
decisions: Engineered atomic database transactions rather than client-side stock deductions
Enforced organization-level multi-tenancy at the database level using Row-Level Security
featuredProjects.results: Demonstrates enterprise full-stack backend rigor, data integrity under concurrency, and secure payment processing.

featuredProjects.name: Learnova — 3D Learning Platform
featuredProjects.tagline: Interactive 3D educational ecosystem with gamified progression and verified certificates.
featuredProjects.positioning: A 3D educational platform featuring video lessons, graded interactive quizzes, XP progression, streak tracking, and tamper-resistant digital certificates.
featuredProjects.description: Learnova combines interactive 3D UI environments with structured course learning. Students progress through video lessons, test their skills with graded quizzes, gain XP and streaks, and earn shareable certificates with unique verification codes.
featuredProjects.problem: Traditional e-learning platforms are static and unengaging, leading to high student drop-off rates and lack of credible credential verification.
featuredProjects.solution: Learnova introduces interactive 3D UI environments, streak and XP gamification, interactive quizzes with instant grading, and automated certificate generation with unique verification hashes.
features: Video lesson player with interactive timeline chaptering
Graded interactive quizzes with immediate feedback and explanation
XP leveling, daily streak tracking, and learner achievement badges
Automated certificate generation with anti-tamper unique verification codes
Instructor course creation studio for building and publishing educational tracks
architecture: Next.js and React frontend with dynamic lesson routing
Three.js canvas rendering interactive 3D learning nodes and badges
State management for real-time progress, score calculation, and streaks
Deployed to Vercel
decisions: Implemented lightweight Three.js components for immersive visual interaction without lag
Designed tamper-resistant unique verification codes for credible credentials
featuredProjects.results: Highlights creative frontend capabilities, 3D interactive design, and comprehensive educational application architecture.

featuredProjects.name: TaskFlow — Evolution of Todo
featuredProjects.tagline: AI-assisted task architecture with priority matrix and Neon PostgreSQL.
featuredProjects.positioning: An intelligent productivity system built for a hackathon, featuring AI-assisted task breakdown, priority tagging, secure authentication, and Neon PostgreSQL.
featuredProjects.description: TaskFlow re-engineers task management with intelligent prioritization tags, subtask hierarchy, cloud database synchronization with Neon PostgreSQL, and an intuitive high-velocity UI.
featuredProjects.problem: Simple todo apps fail to scale when projects grow complex, lacking priority logic, intelligent breakdown, and cloud database persistence.
featuredProjects.solution: TaskFlow re-engineers task management with intelligent prioritization tags, subtask hierarchy, cloud database synchronization with Neon PostgreSQL, and an intuitive high-velocity UI.
features: Intelligent task categorization with priority tags (Urgent, High, Normal, Low)
AI-assisted task decomposition into actionable milestone steps
Secure user authentication and cloud persistence powered by Neon PostgreSQL
Real-time completion analytics and productivity progress tracking
Responsive, keyboard-accessible dark-mode interface
architecture: Next.js App Router for optimal rendering speed
Neon Serverless PostgreSQL for fast distributed SQL queries
Tailwind CSS for responsive layout design
Deployed on Vercel
decisions: Selected Neon serverless PostgreSQL for instant branchable cloud database storage
Prioritized keyboard navigation and instant optimistic UI updates
